fields.description:
## Context / Problem
T13 (1,939 agentic runs), T14 (1,939), removal-rationale (1,722), and asserted-capability (409) have produced zero findings ever — ~7,900 wasted agentic executions. An adversarial false-negative audit amended the draft triggers (mechanism-of-enforcement vocabulary for T13; a structured file_impact condition plus scheduler/release vocabulary for T14; weakening vocabulary for removal-rationale; two regex bug fixes for asserted-capability). Amended fire rates over 743 reviewed non-bug tickets: 84.0% / 61.6% / 86.5% / 96.5%.

## Approach
T13 and T14 are overlay criteria (registry.is_overlay matches T-prefixed ids) and extend the existing _DET_OVERLAY_RULES path (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py:452-457). removal-rationale and asserted-capability are leaf-routed, NOT overlays, so they get a parallel _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES table plus a second gate block in orchestrator.route_criteria after the overlay block (the existing guard at orchestrator.py:392 is is_overlay-gated and cannot serve them). Rule schema: a DetGateRule dataclass {text_re: str | None, file_impact_globs: list[str], requires_declared_deletion: bool} — a rule fires if the text regex matches the plan OR any file_impact path matches a glob OR (when requires_declared_deletion) the ticket declares a deleted file; overlay_triggers gains an optional file_impact parameter threaded from route_criteria for the structured conditions. A not-fired rule skips the criterion with an explicit coverage entry naming the trigger; a fired rule routes to the LLM exactly as today. sizing.py's is_overlay call sites are audited for the new table. Criteria and rubrics are untouched — this is gating, not removal.

Trigger regexes (case-insensitive; transcribed from the audit, provenance ticket 696a):
- T13: `\b(?:block\w*|reject\w*|refus\w*|enforc\w*|den(?:y|ies|ied)\b|forbid\w*|prohibit\w*|disallow\w*|outlaw\w*|must (?:pass|not)\b|cannot (?:merge|close|claim|submit|land|push)|fail(?:s|ing)? (?:the )?(?:build|ci|check|gate)|gate[sd]? (?:on|behind)|require\w*[^.\n]{0,60}\bbefore\b|no longer (?:allowed|permitted|accepts?)|restrict\w*|bounce\w*|veto\w*|\bbar(?:s|red|ring)\b|exit(?:s|ing)?\s+(?:code\s+)?(?:non-?zero|[0-9]+)|\bnon-?zero\b|raises?\s+\w*(?:Error|Exception)|\bunless\b|prerequisite\w*|precondition\w*|hard\s+(?:requirement|stop|fail)|only\s+[^.\n]{0,40}\b(?:may|can|are\s+allowed)\b|now\s+(?:needs|requires)|turns?\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:run|build|ci)\s+red|goes\s+red|\bgate\w*\b|\bhook\w*\b)`
- T14 text: `(?:\.github/workflows|\bworkflows?\b|workflow_dispatch|pull_request_target|\bcron\b|schedul\w*|refs?/(?:for|heads|tags|meta)|branch(?:es)?\s*[:=]|branch (?:pattern|namespace|filter)|git ref|tag (?:push|pattern|creation)|release (?:script|pipeline|process|workflow|job)|new (?:ci )?job|entry[- ]?point|ci (?:job|trigger|run|pipeline|gate|workflow)|github actions|package (?:publish|release)|pypi|gerrit-verify|\bnightly\b|\bweekly\b|\bhourly\b|\blaunchd\b|launch\s?agent|dependabot|\brunner\b|\bmakefile\b|pre-(?:push|commit|receive)|commit-msg|console[-_ ]scripts?|\bwheel\b|\bsdist\b|publish\w*|upload\w*[^.\n]{0,40}\b(?:index|registry|artifact)\b|on\s+(?:every\s+)?(?:push|merge|tag)\b|\boidc\b|docker-compose|\bcompose\b|mirror[- ]guard|\bnamespace\b|lands?\s+on\b)` with file_impact_globs [".github/*", "Makefile", "*.pre-commit*", "hooks/*", "*/hooks/*", "pyproject.toml", "*.yml", "*.yaml"]
- removal-rationale text: `\b(?:remov\w*|delet\w*|drop\w*|retir\w*|deprecat\w*|prun\w*|strip\w*|weaken\w*|relax\w*|loosen\w*|eliminat\w*|decommission\w*|sunset\w*|rip(?:ping)? out|dead[- ]code|no longer|obsolet\w*|unus\w*|clean[- ]?up|simplif\w*|consolidat\w*|replac\w*|disabl\w*|bypass\w*|skip\w*|suppress\w*|silenc\w*|\bmut(?:e|ed|ing)\b|swallow\w*|demot\w*|downgrad\w*|soften\w*|supersed\w*|subsum\w*|\bfold(?:s|ed|ing)?\b|collaps\w*|inlin\w*|absorb\w*|\bno[- ]?op\b|waiv\w*|opt[- ]?outs?|turn(?:s|ed|ing)?\s+off|switch(?:es|ed|ing)?\s+off|shrink\w*|narrow\w*|exempt\w*|\bignor\w*|single\s+attempt|fail[- ]fast|\bbecomes?\s+a?\s*warning\b)` with requires_declared_deletion OR-arm
- asserted-capability: conjunction of module-ref leg `(?:[\w/]+\.(?:py|sh|ts|js|go|rs)\b|\b[a-z_]\w*\.[a-z_]\w*\.[a-z_]\w*\b|\b[a-z]+(?:_[a-z0-9]+)+\b|\b(?:module|helper|function|class|subsystem|registry|reducer|adapter|client|store|layer|service|component|pipeline|engine|wrapper|utils?|library|suite|script|hook|gate|sidecar|verifier|reviewer|table|command|test|check|flag)\b)` AND capability-verb leg `\b(?:already\b|exist\w*|lean(?:s|ing)?\s+on|lives?\s+in|\bcovers?\b|takes?\s+care|responsible\s+for|does not (?:have|support|provide|exist|emit|handle)|doesn'?t (?:have|support|provide|exist)|lacks?\b|missing\b|no existing\b|must be (?:built|added|created)|not (?:yet )?(?:present|implemented|supported)|(?:provides|supports|exposes|implements|emits|handles|owns)\b|can(?:not|'t)?\s+(?:handle|do|parse|emit|sign)|(?:won'?t|will\s+not|never|only)\s+\w+|reus\w*|extend\w*|delegates?\s+to|calls?\s+into|nothing\s+in\b|wire\w*)`

Alternative rejected: retiring the criteria — operator ruled they must remain; and the draft narrower regexes — the audit demonstrated realistic evasion classes for each.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py (route_criteria leaf-gate block), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py (is_overlay call-site audit), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json (trigger annotations), tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py (new, beside test_det_citation.py).

## Testing
Unit: every evasion sentence from the audit fires its trigger (parameterized over the recorded sentence lists); minimal non-matching plans skip each criterion with a coverage record and zero LLM routing; the file_impact glob arm fires T14 on a .github/workflows path and the deletion arm fires removal-rationale on a declared deletion with non-matching text; leaf-gated criteria skip through the new route_criteria block, overlay-gated through the existing one; fired plans route unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All audit evasion sentences fire their respective triggers (checked: `pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_det_criterion_gates.py` parameterized over the sentence lists).
- [ ] A plan not firing a trigger skips that criterion with zero LLM routing and a coverage skip entry naming the trigger, for both the overlay pair and the leaf pair (checked: unit tests through route_criteria).
- [ ] The T14 glob arm and the removal-rationale deletion arm fire on file_impact alone with non-matching description text (checked: unit tests).
- [ ] Fired plans route the criterion exactly as before (checked: existing routing tests pass).
